_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your details. Run `node setup.js` to be guided interactively.

person._country_note: 2-letter country code. US (default), CA, GB, AU, etc. Non-US users: 'state' holds province/region; 'zip' holds postal code (any format, e.g. K1A 0A6 or SW1A 1AA); 'phoneFormatted' is the raw phone number with no US formatting.
person._state_note: For non-US: province or region (e.g. ON for Ontario, NSW for New South Wales)
person._zip_note: For non-US: postal code in your country's format (e.g. K1A 0A6, SW1A 1AA, 2000)
person._phone_note: For non-US: phoneFormatted equals phone with no reformatting applied

capsolver._comment: Sign up free at capsolver.com — pay-as-you-go, costs pennies/month for this use case

accounts._comment: For sites that require a login. Leave password blank — setup.js will prompt you to create the account once, then store credentials here.

notify._comment: iMessage number to text results to (macOS only). Leave blank to disable.
notify._webhook_comment: Optional webhook URL for notifications on any OS (ntfy.sh, Slack, Discord). Leave blank to disable.

email._comment: SMTP config for sending opt-out emails. Required — without this, email brokers are logged as 'manual'. Gmail: host=smtp.gmail.com, port=587, use an App Password (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). Outlook/Office365: host=smtp-mail.outlook.com, port=587.

browser._comment: Browser engine config. camofox is first-class default (C++-level fingerprint spoofing).
browser._engine_comment: Options: camofox (default), stealth, chrome, chromium, cdp
browser._cookiesFile_comment: Netscape/cookies.txt export from your browser. Imported on every launch.
browser._profileDir_comment: Where storageState (cookies+localStorage) is persisted across runs.
browser._camoufoxBinary_comment: Optional: path to custom Camoufox binary. Leave blank to use npx camoufox-js fetch version.

proxy._comment: Optional proxy for camofox engine. Remove this block to disable.

browser._proxy_comment: Set proxy.server to route camofox through a proxy. Credentials are optional.
browser._block_webrtc_comment: Prevent WebRTC from leaking your real IP (default: true, highly recommended)
browser._enable_cache_comment: Enable browser disk cache for faster repeated loads (default: true)
browser._block_images_comment: Block image loading. Keep false — broker opt-out forms need images (default: false)
browser._humanize_comment: Randomize mouse movements and timing to appear human (default: true)
browser._geoip_comment: Auto-match browser locale and timezone to your IP geolocation (default: true)
browser._tracing_comment: Record Playwright traces (screenshots+snapshots). Saved as .zip files.
browser._tracingDir_comment: Where to store trace .zip files. Old traces auto-pruned at 20 files.
browser._chromeDataDir_comment: [chrome engine only] Your real Chrome user data dir.
browser._chromeBinary_comment: [chrome engine only] Path to Chrome binary.
browser._cdpUrl_comment: [cdp engine only] URL of running Chrome with --remote-debugging-port.
